instruction: 장비 강화 재료는 책이 아닌 인챈트 주문서. 스킬 강화 재료는 기존 마법북 유지.

assets.name: 후드 인챈트 주문서
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE standalone equipment enchantment SCROLL icon for Unity inventory, transparent alpha background. Image 1 is the authoritative player character: faceless black rounded hood, ragged charcoal robe, little ivory skull ornaments, angular wood/bone staff with a mint green orb. Image 2 is the approved ART STYLE: thick rough black wax-crayon outlines, coarse scribbled flat fills, white pigment gaps, chunky naive hand-drawn doodle. Match this style. A vertically unfurled ivory aged parchment scroll, irregular ragged edges, one simple curled roll at top and another curled lip at bottom; muted warm grey parchment shadows, large open central face. Draw exactly one very large simple equipment symbol with black charcoal outlines, slate grey / ivory / mint green fills at center. Two short mint-green crayon enchantment strokes underneath, no writing, no tiny runes. About 72 percent square canvas occupancy, generous transparent margins, readable at 64px, no background glow, no frames, no watermark. This item is an enchantment scroll; no book covers, book spines, page stacks or standalone gear beside the scroll.
Central symbol: a black rounded drooping empty hood with no face.
